title: fix(app-showcase): enforce the invoice ownership check on create as well as update
body:
## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:showcase 的 contributor 权限集给发票加了一条"新建时归属校验"(`invoice_owner_on_create`,`operation: 'insert'` 的 RLS `check`),与已有的"修改时归属校验"`invoice_owner_immutable` 成对。
- 为什么改:原有校验只覆盖修改,新建(含克隆)不受约束;现在 contributor 新建或克隆的发票必须归属自己,与其读取范围一致。
- 风险与回滚:只改示例应用的权限声明,平台代码零改动;contributor 新建发票时不填 `owner` 也会被拒(403),回滚即删掉这一条策略。
- 先看:`examples/app-showcase/src/security/permission-sets.ts`(新增策略那一段),再看 `packages/qa/dogfood/test/showcase-invoice-seed-isolation.dogfood.test.ts` 末尾新增用例。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run test/showcase-invoice-seed-isolation.dogfood.test.ts`,预期 19 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `examples/app-showcase/src/security/permission-sets.ts`: the `showcase_contributor` set gains `invoice_owner_on_create`, an `operation: 'insert'` RLS policy carrying the same `check: 'owner == current_user.email'` as the existing update-time `invoice_owner_immutable` (ADR-0058 D4). The platform already enforces an insert `check` through the post-image seam (`postHookWriteImageCheck`, plugin-security `writeCheckPolicies`); the update-only declaration simply did not apply to creates, and a `select` policy's `using` never stands in as an insert check. A separate `insert` policy is used rather than widening the existing rule to `all`, which would also make a check-only policy applicable to select and delete. Clone is a create and is judged by the same rule.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/showcase-invoice-seed-isolation.dogfood.test.ts`: per holder shape (direct set grant and `contributor` position), pins both halves on the shipped set: an own-owner create lands 201 and is readable by its creator; a foreign-owner create and an absent-owner create are refused 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` with nothing written; a foreign-owner clone is refused 403 with nothing written while a same-owner clone lands 201. One more case pins that the admin is unaffected (creates for any owner, 201).
- Platform checklist text kept accurate: `approvals.account-app-entry` (rev 7) and `access-security.owd-sharing-matrix` (rev 7) no longer describe an owner-less contributor create as landing; the `search` area recipe `qa-contributor-bound-member` says the same.

No platform code changes, so no changeset: `examples/app-showcase` and `packages/qa/dogfood` are private and `docs/qa/**` does not publish.

## Tests

Run on the final head (sha below).

<details><summary>Dogfood: the isolation file, 19/19</summary>

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 test/showcase-invoice-seed-isolation.dogfood.test.ts`: `Test Files 1 passed (1)` · `Tests 19 passed (19)`.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation of the new policy: 4 refusal cases red, then restored</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` renamed the policy and narrowed it to a position no contributor holds (anchor 1 → 0, blob 3caf89dd75e0 → 372c5ac8ebb9). The same file then answered `Tests 4 failed | 15 passed (19)`: both holder shapes' foreign-owner create (`expected 201 to be 403`) and foreign-owner clone (`foreign-owner clone: expected 201 to be 403`). Restore was proven by `blob == HEAD (3caf89dd75e0)` and an empty `git diff HEAD`. (A first attempt was a no-op, refused by the script because its replacement text contained the anchor. It was re-run with a different anchor.)

</details>

<details><summary>Neighbouring suites</summary>

- Six showcase security dogfood files (isolation, d3-d4 capabilities, CRUD persona matrix, line contributor pair, expand CRUD gate, permission zoo): `Test Files 6 passed (6)` · `Tests 100 passed (100)`.
- Every other dogfood file naming `showcase_invoice`: `Test Files 14 passed | 1 skipped (15)` · `Tests 81 passed | 8 skipped (89)`.
- `@objectstack/example-showcase`: `typecheck` exit 0; `vitest run` `Test Files 41 passed (41)` · `Tests 505 passed (505)`.
- `@objectstack/dogfood` `typecheck` exit 0.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- A contributor's create that omits `owner` is now refused 403 too, because `owner` is a plain text field with no default. Before, that create landed and its creator could not see it. Giving `owner` a current-user default would be a separate showcase change.
- Other showcase objects with email-based owner RLS: only `showcase_task` (`task_own_rows`, `assignee == current_user.email`, select only). It carries no ownership `check` at all, and assigning a task to a colleague is a legitimate create, so it is not the same shape. It is deliberately left out.
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/search.json` (recipe step 3 of `qa-contributor-bound-member`) still says `invoice_own_rows` lists `positions: ['contributor']`. The shipped policy lists no positions. That text existed before this PR and is not touched here.

## Verification

All readings above and below were taken at head `176cd526` (objectstack-ai/objectstack, merge base `7e200b4a6`).

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (no paths) derived 59 families for the 5 changed paths. 57 exited 0. `check:query-options-erasure` hit a 240 s runner timeout once, then was re-run alone and exited 0 (`ratchet holds: 50 unswept non-test site(s)`). `check:platform-checklist` and `check:nul-bytes` exited 0.

Two families are NOT MEASURED. Each exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET), so neither measured anything:
- `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` needs an unshallow clone for its pinned fixture.
- `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` needs a whole-workspace build.

Neither reads a path this diff touches, and CI runs both.

The `--ran` reconciliation (with exit codes) answered: `59 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 57 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED (2 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)`.

</details>
